content: Israel-dulemar na e-isgued barsogsamalad

Esdras Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-asabin, Israel-dulemar-isgusad-ular, ise-boale, degi, yokorgi-sindigar, Bab-Dummadse gorsiidgine, bukidar Israel-dulemar: Machergan, omegan, mimmiganse-bakale, ese ambikunonikid. A-dulemar, bela ise-boedbimarmogad.

Geb degine, Jehiel-machi-Secanías, Elam-wagangi-danikid, Esdrasʼse aligusad. Geb weyob ega sogded: “Anmar, omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad nikus-nanasoggu, anmar-Bab-Dummadgi nue-nosad. Degi-inigwele, amba sunna anmar bendakleged.

Degisoggu, anmar, anmar-Bab-Dummadbo, igar mesmardo. Emi, bela we-omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad anmar metemaloye, mimmigangi bangumarbaloye, be anmargala binsaed-uksadba, deyob anmar imakodo. Degi, dule-Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba-nanadimalad-sogsamogadba, deyob anmar imakodo.” Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad-Igar-Maidba imaklesundo.
Geb degi, Esdrasʼga sogdemalad: “Gwichibin be imake, ar we-igarde be imakergebed, ar anmar be-bendakmogoed, gandik be-sae, be ibmar imake.”

Degidgine, Esdras gwichibin imaksad. Geb Esdras, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, Levita-dulemala, bela Israel-dulemala ibmar-sogsamaladba-ise-sogar-imakega, imaksad. Degisoggu, Israel-dulemala ise-sogar eyeye na sogsamalad, deyob imakmaloye.

Geb agi, Esdras, Bab-Dummadse-goled-neg-asabin-sii nadsunnad. Geb Johanán-e-gabednegse naded. Johanánʼde, Eliasib-machid. Agine, dulemar-galesgusmalad-gannar-nonimalad-e-isgusadba, Esdras, nue bukib-binsaedba, gwen gobsasuli, mas-guchasuli, gabided.
Geb sorbali, dulemar-galesgusmalad-nonimaladse gorlesad. We-dulemarse gorlesad: Judá-yalagi-bukmaladse, degi, Jerusalénʼgi-bukmaladse. Ega weyob soglesad: “Jerusalén-neggweburse ambikunonimaloye.”

Degi, ega soglesbalid: “Dule ibapaagwadgi nonisulile, bela ei e-nainumar-nikadi sulegoye. Ar igi-dummagan, degi, Judío-girmar-dummagan igar-mesisa, deyob guoye. Degi, dulemar-galesgusmalad-nonimalad-imbagi, bemar-ononnolegoye,” ega soglesad.

Geb degine, a-ibapaagwadgi, bela machergan Judá-yarginmalad, degi, Benjamín-yarginmalad, Jerusalén-neggweburse ambikunonimalad. Deunni, nii-walabakebakgi, e-iba-durgwengi, bela dulemar Bab-Dummadse-goled-neggi ambikued-neg-naidgi ambikusmalad. Degi, weyob ibmar-soglesadba, nue dobee itodmalad. De-ukinbali, dii nue-winaibarsoggu, a-bakas bela-belad wawanmakbukwad.

Geb degi, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras gwichibin imaksad. Geb amarga weyob sogded: —Bemar, bela-belad Bab-Dummadgi nue isgusad, omegan-Israel-dulemarsurmalad be nikusmalad. Degidbali, bela-belad Israel-dulemar-isguega be imaksamalad.

Emi, anmar-dadgan-e-Bab-Dummad-Jehová-asabin, be-isgusmalad be barsogmarsun. Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abegedba be imakmalo. Degine, dule-Bab-Jehová-wissurmaladgi be bangumalo, omegan-be-dulamarsulid be metemalo.
Geb, bela dulemar gandikidba, Esdras-abin sogdemalad: —Ar deyobdo. Degiirdi nabir, be-sogedba anmar imako.

Degi-inigwele, anmar bukidarsoggu, degine, diide nue-winaibarsoggu, anmar geg weyob magaba bukwa gued. Ar we-igarde binsa ibagwenadye, degi, ibabogwadye soglesulid, ar ade, anmar bukidar na we-igargi isgusmaladbiid.

”Degisoggu, anmar sogsundo, dule e-neggweburga-dummadga-gudimalad, e-sordagan-ular, wegi beoye, adi, amar-ular sunmakegar. Geb dulemar-omegan-Israel-dulesulid-nikusmalad iba-sogedba nonimaloed. Wemar dule-dummagan-abargi, dule-igar-nabiromalad-abargi, degi, e-neggwebur-e-neggwebur-iliba wese nonimaloed. Adi, Bab-Dummad anmar egi-isgusad-ular anmarse-urwemaidi, melle bar anmarse urwegar.”
Geb degi, unnila Asael-machi-Jonatán, Ticva-machi-Jahazías, wemar-ebogwad, we-ibmar-sogsamaladgi gwisgusad, degine, Levita-dulemar-ebogwad Mesulam, Sabetai, we-dulemarba nai gusmarmogad.

Dulemar-gales-selesgusmalad-nonimaladdi, na sogedba imaksad. Geb degine, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-Esdras, neguya-gwenna-gwennagi dummadga-gudimalad amisad, adi, dulemar-omegan-Israel-dulesulid-nikusmaladga igar-amiegar. Geb, nii-warambegi, a-ibagwenadgi, dulemar e-neggweburmar-ular dummadga-besmaladi na igar-amidmalad.
Degi, gebe-nii-yolesad-ibagwenadgi, bela-dulemar omegan-Israel-dulemarsulid-nikusmaladga igar-nabiroleged bergusad.
Dulemar-omegan-Israel-dulemarsulid-nikusmalad-e-nugmar

content.text: degi, e-gwenadgan: Maasías, Eliezer, Jarib, Gedalías.

content: We-dulemar na nue-ise-sogar sogsamalad, we-omegan-Israel-dulesurmalad anmar metemaloye. Degine, amarde, e-isgued-eliega, Bab-Dummadga sibad-wawaad-machered-wargwen ogumakar uksamarbalid.

content: Bela-wemar, omegan-Israel-dulemarsurmalad-nikusmaladid. Geb degi, na e-omegangi bangudmarsunnad, e-mimmigangi aibatemarsunnad.
